purpose: Bounded official Windows SDK prerequisite for native Windows CI (Chromium pinned SDK_VERSION 10.0.28000.0). Disposable runner install only.

chromium_requires.note: Pinned checkout hardcodes SDK_VERSION in build/vs_toolchain.py and build/toolchain/win/setup_toolchain.py; a GN arg cannot override both. Do not downgrade to 26100.

installer.verified_host: Coordinator on macOS observed only downloaded installer SHA256, byte size, and PE ProductName/CompanyName/FileVersion. Authenticode Valid/Microsoft, installation, and installed servicing observation are enforced by install-win-sdk.ps1 on the disposable Windows runner at CI time (not observed on the coordinator host).
installer.verification_scope: Pin integrity (hash/size/PE identity) is coordinator-observed. Installer trust and SDK installation are runtime-enforced expectations, not coordinator claims.

authenticode_policy.note: Windows Get-AuthenticodeSignature only. Fail closed if not Valid or publisher differs.

install_features_source: Documented WinSDKSetup.exe /features OptionId.* list (Desktop C++ x86/x64 headers+libs+tools, Debugging Tools for Windows). No ISO, no unpinned choco/latest, no vendor patch.
install_scope: Disposable GitHub Actions runner only. No local Mac installation. No product-installer work.
